drafts.subject: AED 48,000 overdue - request payment after 15 Nov
drafts.body:
Dear Gulf Star Supermarkets team,

Our records show AED 48,000 is 61 to 90 days overdue. You noted payment after 15 Nov and we ask you to keep to that date.

We value our long relationship and your large account. Your credit limit is 150,000 and our contract allows us to suspend deliveries when amounts are over 30 days overdue. We wish to avoid that step.

Please confirm payment date.

Finance team, Falcon Trading LLC

drafts.tone: dispute path: acknowledge claim, separate undisputed amount
drafts.subject: AED 52,000 overdue and FT-S-0066 dispute
drafts.body:
Dear Oasis Hotels FZE team,

We note AED 52,000 is over 90 days overdue and your plan to pay 26,000 in mid Nov and 26,000 in mid Dec.

We also note your dispute for AED 12,000 under FT-S-0066 for water damaged linen. Our contract states undisputed amounts stay payable on time and disputes go to finance directors within 14 days.

Please pay the undisputed balance on time and let us start the dispute review.

Finance team, Falcon Trading LLC

drafts.subject: AED 40,000 overdue - confirm 20 Nov and 10 Dec plan
drafts.body:
Dear Sharjah Wholesale Co team,

Our records show AED 40,000 is 31 to 60 days overdue. Thank you for offering 20,000 on 20 Nov and 20,000 on 10 Dec.

We support this plan and ask you to lock in both dates. Please confirm so we can record the schedule.

We value your business and wish to help you stay on track.

Finance team, Falcon Trading LLC

drafts.subject: Request 30 day extension PI-0050 PI-0014 PI-0037 PI-0013
drafts.body:
Dear Zenith Electronics FZCO team,

Invoices PI-0050, PI-0014, PI-0037 and PI-0013 total about AED 60,400 and fall due 18 to 25 Nov, our tightest weeks. Our contract terms are 60 days.

We ask for 30 more days on these invoices. We note your planned 3 percent increase from 1 Dec. In return we can offer an early volume commitment.

Please let us know if this works.

Finance team, Falcon Trading LLC

drafts.subject: Request 30 day extension PI-0044 due 20 Nov
drafts.body:
Dear Sahara Freight Services team,

Invoice PI-0044 for AED 8,790.54 is due 20 Nov. We ask for 30 more days to pay.

We note fuel surcharge stays flat in Nov. Thank you.

Please confirm if the extension is possible.

Finance team, Falcon Trading LLC

drafts.subject: PI-0012 pricing error - request credit note AED 3,738.35
drafts.body:
Dear Palm Foods Import team,

Invoice PI-0012 bills basmati at AED 12.50 per kg, but our contract fixes AED 11.00. Price changes need 60 days notice and a signed amendment.

This overbilled AED 3,738.35 with VAT. Please issue a credit note within 14 days as required. We will hold PI-0012 until then.

Please confirm.

Finance team, Falcon Trading LLC
